audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side was "Skill" on all seven rows while content win[] reads Brand/Brand/Neeko/Brand/Skill/Skill/Skill — the same chart the packet carries. The page answered "who wins Level 1" two different ways.
audit.why: Pillar of Flame is a 900-range zone on a 10s cooldown; at levels 1-2 Neeko has no passive HP cushion and no root yet, so those levels are his. Level 3 unlocks the 1000-range E into Q, the one clean kill window. Ranks in W and Conflagration take the poke war back at 4-5.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side Brand, [1] Brand, [2] Neeko, [3] Brand, [4-6] left Skill; the whys for rows 0, 1 and 3 rewritten to describe Brand winning them.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer spike story ran Level 3 -> Level 6 -> Luden's, all crediting Neeko, and ignored the level 4-5 dip the content layer records.
audit.why: content whys[3] and spikes[0] both say the level 3 window closes as his W and E ranks up. Level 6 is an even ult trade: Pop Blossom kills him, a chained Pyroclasm kills you.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten to name the single kill window at 3, the even ult trade at 6, and the flat item curve after.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit anywhere (defect catalogue item 3), and the decisive interaction was stated only vaguely as "the stun line is the dodge that matters".
audit.why: The real mechanic from the kits: Blaze is applied by his spells; Sear only stuns a target that is already ablaze. If you never take Pillar of Flame or Conflagration, Sear is a 1050-range damage projectile and nothing more. Cooldowns: Sear 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, Pillar of Flame 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, Conflagration 13/12/11/10/9 at 625 range, Pyroclasm 100/90/80, Neeko E 12/11.5/11/10.5/10.
audit.corrected: Sear is 8s at rank 1, 6s maxed, and only stuns while you are ablaze — stay unlit and it is just a 1050-range poke; Pillar of Flame is 10s, so step in once it lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: No punishable window was named with a number.
audit.why: Pillar of Flame at 10s rank 1 is the spell that zones her; the window after it lands is when Neeko's 1000-range E can reach.
audit.corrected: Numbers added for Sear, Pillar of Flame and Neeko's E.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.wave was the champion-agnostic clone template and never mentioned Blaze or AoE.
audit.why: A wave parked inside Pillar of Flame keeps Blaze on her, which is exactly the condition Sear's stun needs.
audit.corrected: Wave advice rewritten around keeping the wave out of his AoE and clearing outside 625-range Conflagration.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed (defect 2): dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim, and dontsFull[1].d ("Spend the root on chip") carried the clone paragraph instead of anything about the root.
audit.why: Each title promised one thing and its body explained another.
audit.corrected: All three bodies replaced with Brand-grounded content matching their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interactions file flags Pillar of Flame as denying Pop Blossom; the page never mentioned it.
audit.why: Pillar of Flame carries the terrain and zone flags in the kit data. The kit text describes a delayed AoE, not a wall, so the honest statement is that it punishes the stationary Pop Blossom wind-up rather than that it blocks the leap.
audit.corrected: Stated as: a disguised walk-in with no R banked leaves you standing in his AoE. Not asserted as a hard block.
